contract:
B25 was never built, so build the follow axis in from line one. Calls routes by URL only; imports nothing from F1-F3. Runtime needs F1 (follow + followers routes) and F3 (invite-candidates ?source=followers); until they ship the follow buttons 404 and the sheet opens on 'Type at least 2 letters'.

A) src/lib/orgs/join-copy.ts — PURE. ZERO runtime imports: only `import type { JoinState, JoinPolicy, OrgAudience, OrgRole } from "./join-state"` (type imports are erased; a runtime import breaks node --test, join-state.test.ts:9-14). Re-declare the literal "signed_out".
Types: `OrgDisplayState = JoinState | "signed_out"`; `FollowSource = "profile" | "discover" | "onboarding"` (never 'join', which only the trigger writes); `OrgActionKind = "follow"|"unfollow"|"join"|"request"|"accept"|"decline"|"sign_in"|"verify_email"|"status"`; `OrgAction = { kind; label: string; sub: string|null; tone: "filled"|"outline"|"quiet"; disabled: boolean; href: string|null }`; `OrgRelation = { handle: string; orgName: string; state: OrgDisplayState; following: boolean; role: OrgRole|null; reason: "policy"|"visiting"|null; audience: OrgAudience; joinPolicy: JoinPolicy|null }` (joinPolicy null only for /api/me/org-invites rows; `following` is forced true when state==='member').
Constants: `FOLLOWER_COUNT_FLOOR = 5` (C13; F1/F2 should import this instead of restating it); `FOLLOW_DISCLOSURE = "Officers can see who follows this club."`; `ORG_COPY` = a frozen object holding every string below, so B13's vanilla twin can copy it character for character.
F (follow toggle) = following ? {kind:'unfollow', label:'Following ✓', tone:'quiet'} : {kind:'follow', label:'Follow', tone:'filled'}.

`orgHeaderView(rel) -> { follow: OrgAction|null; followSub: string|null; membership: OrgAction[]; disclosure: string|null }` (org page; both axes; first match wins):
- signed_out: follow {sign_in 'Sign in to follow', filled, href '/auth/login?next=' + encodeURIComponent('/orgs/' + handle)}; membership [].
- member: follow {status 'Following ✓', quiet, disabled}, followSub 'Members follow automatically'; membership [{status 'Joined ✓', quiet, disabled}].
- hidden (platform admin, non-member): follow null; membership [{status 'Hidden', disabled, sub 'Hidden by Vibe. Only members can see it.'}].
- invited: F; [{accept 'Accept invite', filled}, {decline 'Decline', outline}].
- can_join: F; [{join 'Join', outline}].
- can_request reason policy: F; [{request 'Request to join', outline, sub 'Officers approve requests'}]. reason visiting: same with sub "You're visiting, so officers approve requests".
- requested: F; [{status 'Requested', quiet, disabled}].
- invite_only: F; [{status 'Invite only', disabled, sub 'Officers invite members'}].
- audience_blocked: F; [{status 'IU students only' | 'Purdue students only', disabled, sub '{org} is open to IU students only.' | '{org} is open to Purdue students only.'}].
- unverified: F; [{verify_email 'Verify your school email to join', outline, href '/auth/school-email'}].
disclosure = FOLLOW_DISCLOSURE iff joinPolicy is 'request' or 'invite' AND state not in {member, hidden, signed_out}.

`orgRowView(rel, surface: "phone_row"|"card") -> { chip: "Invited you"|"Following"|null; actions: OrgAction[]; layout: "slot"|"line"; disclosure: string|null; meta: string[] }` (Discover rows, phone Orgs tab, quick view, onboarding; C16 founder rule: open clubs show Follow AND Join together; request clubs keep follow-then-request):
| state | phone_row | card | chip |
| signed_out | [sign_in 'Sign in to follow'] slot | same | null |
| member | [status 'Joined ✓' quiet disabled] slot | same | null |
| hidden | [status 'Hidden' disabled] slot | same | null |
| invited | [accept 'Accept' filled] slot (Decline lives on the org page) | [accept 'Accept invite' filled, decline 'Decline' outline] | 'Invited you' |
| can_join, not following | [follow 'Follow' filled, join 'Join' outline] layout LINE | same two | null |
| can_join, following | [unfollow 'Following ✓' quiet, join 'Join' filled] layout LINE | same two | null |
| can_request, not following | [follow 'Follow' filled] slot | same | null |
| can_request, following | [request 'Request' filled] slot | [unfollow 'Following ✓' quiet, request 'Request to join' outline] | phone_row 'Following', card null |
| requested / invite_only / audience_blocked / unverified | [F] slot | [F] | null |
layout is 'line' ONLY for phone_row + can_join; card layout is always 'slot'. Exactly one tone:'filled' action per view at most. The chip never repeats a rendered control ('Following' appears only when no 'Following ✓' control is rendered). No 'Joined' chip in v1: the 'Joined ✓' control says it everywhere.
meta (caller prefixes '@handle' and appends memberCountText): policy request->'By request', invite->'Invite only', open/null->omitted; then 'Requested' iff state requested; then audience iu->'IU only', purdue->'Purdue only', both->omitted; then 'Hidden' iff state hidden.
disclosure = FOLLOW_DISCLOSURE iff joinPolicy is 'request' or 'invite' AND actions include a follow or unfollow action.

Text helpers (all return string|null): `policyChip(p)` open 'Open' / request 'By request' / invite 'Invite only'; `audienceChip(a)` 'IU only' / 'Purdue only' / null; `followerCountText(n)` null when n is null or n < 5, else '{n} followers'; `memberCountText(n)` null when null, '1 member', '{n} members'; `followsSinceText(iso)` 'Follows since {Mon D}' (toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric'}), invalid -> null); `inviteSubText(firstName, expiresIso)` 'Invited by {first name} · Expires {Mon D}' or 'Invited by an officer · Expires {Mon D}'; `whoCanJoinFact(p)` 'Anyone' / 'By request' / 'By invitation'; `openToFact(a)` 'Anyone' / 'IU students' / 'Purdue students'; `WHO_CAN_JOIN_OPTIONS` = open 'Anyone can join' sub 'Join instantly', request 'Request to join' sub 'Officers approve requests', invite 'Invite only' sub 'Officers invite members' (invites critic C1 labels); `openToOptions(campus: {name: string; shared: boolean} | null)` = both: shared ? 'All of {name} (IU + Purdue)' : 'IU and Purdue students', iu 'IU students only', purdue 'Purdue students only'; `OFFICER_FOLLOW_HELP = "Anyone can follow your club. This only sets who becomes a member."`; `AUDIENCE_HELP = "Checked against each student's verified school email when they join."` (invites critic A9); `MOD_READONLY = "Only owners and admins can change this."`.
`joinPolicyNotice({state, joinPolicy, audience, orgName, hidden})`: hidden (viewer is member or admin) -> "This org is hidden. Only its members can find it. It's out of lists, search and events."; else member -> null; audience_blocked -> '{org} only takes IU students as members. You can still follow.' / '{org} only takes Purdue students as members. You can still follow.'; joinPolicy invite -> 'Invite only. Anyone can follow this club — officers add members.'; request -> 'Anyone can follow this club. Officers approve members.'; open -> null.
`channelsGateCopy(rel) -> {line: string; inline: OrgAction|null} | null`: member -> null; can_join -> 'Chats are for members. Join to start talking.' + inline {join 'Join'}; can_request -> 'Chats are for members. Officers approve who joins.' + inline {request 'Request to join'}; requested -> 'Chats are for members. Officers approve who joins.' no inline; invite_only -> 'Chats are for members. Officers invite members.' no inline; invited -> 'Chats are for members. Accept the invite to start talking.' no inline; unverified -> 'Chats are for members. Verify your school email to join.' no inline; audience_blocked, hidden, signed_out -> 'Chats are for members.' no inline.
`orgErrorCopy(code, ctx)`: not_found "This org isn't available."; 429 'Too many tries. Try again in a minute.'; member_follows 'Members follow automatically.'; org_hidden 'This org is hidden, so nobody new can join it.'; invite_not_found / invite_not_pending 'This invite is no longer open.'; invite_only / audience_mismatch / school_unverified -> null (state flips, no toast).

B) src/lib/orgs/join-copy.test.ts: `node --test --experimental-strip-types`, dynamic import through a specifier variable exactly like join-state.test.ts:20. Walk all 10 OrgDisplayState x following {true,false} x joinPolicy {open,request,invite,null} x surface {phone_row,card} plus orgHeaderView: 1-2 actions, labels non-empty, at most one filled, no follow/unfollow action for member/hidden/signed_out, layout 'line' only for phone_row+can_join, disclosure non-null iff (request|invite) and a follow control rendered, chip never equals a rendered control's state. followerCountText(null)=null, (4)=null, (5)='5 followers'; memberCountText(1)='1 member'. A source-text assertion that every `import` line in join-copy.ts starts with `import type`.

C) src/components/orgs/OrgJoinControl.tsx ('use client'). Props `{ relation: OrgRelation; variant: "header"|"phone_row"|"card"; axis?: "both"|"membership" (header only, default both); source: FollowSource; pendingInviteId?: string|null; onChange?: (next: { state: OrgDisplayState; following: boolean; role: OrgRole|null; declined?: true }) => void }`. Renders orgHeaderView (header) or orgRowView(...).actions (phone_row/card). Header renders ONE wrapper element (globals.css:2733-2736 forces `.vibe-org-header-join > *` to width 100%) with flex-wrap rows: follow column (button + followSub + disclosure, 12px muted) and membership column (buttons + sub). Every tappable control min-height 44px; follow toggle has aria-pressed={following}. phone_row 'line' layout: two pills flex:1 side by side. No optimistic flips: the pressed control shows '…' and aria-busy until the server answers (MessagesMobile.tsx:1203-1234 pattern). All calls go through vibeRequest with quiet:true; codes below are handled, anything else toasts `r.message` with `r.action` (keeps terms_required's Review Terms action).
- follow: POST `/api/orgs/{handle}/follow` json {source} (failure "Couldn't follow this club.") -> ok: following=true. not_found -> toast "This org isn't available." and disable.
- unfollow: DELETE `/api/orgs/{handle}/follow` (failure "Couldn't unfollow this club.") -> ok: following=false. 409 member_follows -> state member, following true, toast 'Members follow automatically.'
- join / request / accept: POST `/api/orgs/{handle}/join` json {} (failures "Couldn't join this org." / "Couldn't send your join request." / "Couldn't accept the invite."). {joined:true, role} -> state member, role, following true; accept additionally toasts "You're in. Welcome to {org}." {pending:true} -> requested. invite_only -> invite_only; audience_mismatch -> audience_blocked (relation.audience = response audience); school_unverified -> unverified; not_found -> toast + disable; org_hidden -> toast.
- decline: `window.confirm("Decline the invite to {org}? An officer can invite you again later.")`, then POST `/api/me/org-invites/{pendingInviteId}` json {action:'decline'} (failure "Couldn't decline the invite."). ok -> onChange({..., declined:true}) with state = joinPolicy open ? can_join : invite ? invite_only : can_request (reason policy); parents refetch. invite_not_found / invite_not_pending -> toast 'This invite is no longer open.' + onChange declined.
- 429 anywhere -> toast 'Too many tries. Try again in a minute.'
- sign_in / verify_email render as next/link anchors.
Source mapping callers must use: org page 'profile'; phone + desktop Orgs tab rows and quick view 'discover'; onboarding 'onboarding'.

D) src/components/orgs/OrgInviteBanner.tsx ('use client' not required). Props `{ orgName: string; inviterFirstName: string|null; expiresAt: string }`. Title "You're invited to join {org}"; sub inviteSubText(...). NO buttons in v1: its only consumer is the org page, whose header already carries 'Accept invite' + 'Decline' (avoids two Accept buttons on one page). Styled like the MessagesMobile.tsx:1657-1723 bar.

E) src/components/orgs/OrgInviteSheet.tsx ('use client'). Props `{ handle: string; orgName: string; audience: OrgAudience; presentation: "sheet"|"modal"|"inline"; onClose?: () => void }`. 'sheet' uses vaul Drawer like MutualsSheet.tsx:4; 'modal' is a centered dialog; 'inline' renders in place (desktop settings tab). Title 'Invite people'. Search input placeholder 'Search by name or @handle', 250ms debounce, AbortController per query.
- q empty: GET `/api/orgs/{handle}/invite-candidates?source=followers` (F3); section label 'Followers'; each row sub followsSinceText(follows_since); 'Show more' when next_cursor is present (passes cursor). Empty: 'Nobody follows {org} yet. Share the club's page — people who follow it show up here.'
- q length 1: 'Type at least 2 letters'. q >= 2: GET `?q=`. Empty: 'No one found. Check the spelling of their handle.'
- Load failure: <LoadFailed failure={{message: "Couldn't load people."}} onRetry>.
- can_invite false: a banner above the list with blocked_reason org_unverified -> 'Get this org verified before inviting people. Message Vibe to start that.' / org_hidden -> "This org is hidden, so it can't invite anyone."; every Invite button disabled.
- Row: avatar, name, @handle, major/year (followers list: follows-since line instead). Right button by `state` FIRST, `eligible` only on state 'none' (invite-candidates/route.ts:113-131): none+eligible 'Invite' -> POST `/api/orgs/{handle}/invites` {user_id} -> 'Invited ✓' + 'Undo' link (DELETE `/api/orgs/{handle}/invites/{id}`, toast 'Invite revoked'), toast 'Invite sent'; invited 'Invited' disabled; member 'Member' disabled; requested 'Approve request' -> POST `/api/orgs/{handle}/requests/{request_id}` {action:'approve'} -> 'Member' + toast "They're in. Their request was approved." (critic A11: never admit through the invite POST); declined_recently 'Declined' disabled + sub 'You can invite again {Mon D}' (available_at); invite_cap_reached 'Invited enough' disabled + sub 'You can invite again {Mon D}'; none+ineligible 'Not eligible' disabled + sub '{org} is open to IU students only.' / '{org} is open to Purdue students only.' / reason unverified "They haven't verified a school email yet.".
- Invite POST codes flip the row instead of a red failure: already_member -> Member; has_pending_request -> requested with request_id; recently_declined / invite_cap_reached -> those states with available_at; audience_mismatch -> Not eligible; 429 toast "You've sent a lot of invites. Try again in an hour."; org_hidden / org_unverified -> toast the server message.
- Below results: 'Pending invites ({n})' from GET `/api/orgs/{handle}/invites`; row 'Invited {relative} by {first name}' or 'Invited {relative} by an officer'; 'Revoke' -> confirm 'Revoke this invite?' with buttons 'Revoke' / 'Keep'; empty 'No pending invites.'
acceptance: `node --test --experimental-strip-types src/lib/orgs/join-copy.test.ts src/lib/orgs/join-state.test.ts` passes; npx tsc --noEmit clean; eslint count not above HEAD.
`grep -rn "from \"@/app/api" src/components/orgs` returns nothing (routes by URL only).

Try again in a minute.'

Network log: follow POST body is exactly {"source":"profile"} from the org page and {"source":"discover"} from Orgs tab rows; no request fires before the tap; the button never changes label before the response.

OrgInviteSheet screenshots (overrides, no prod writes): followers default list, followers empty, search results covering every state, can_invite false (org_unverified), 429 toast; the requested row calls /requests/{request_id} with {action:'approve'}, never /invites.
